title: Documentation Is a Love Letter to Future You
excerpt: Future you is tired, under pressure, and has forgotten everything. Be kind to them.
body:
In support, the best tickets were the ones a good doc had already answered. The worst were the ones where the doc was confidently wrong.

Now I write the README as I build, not after. If I can't explain a step simply, the step is probably too complicated.

Nobody ever got paged at 2am because the docs were too clear.
